hero.subtitle: Innovation, sensitivity and a more human digital presence.

intro.title: An immersive experience that brings emotional wellbeing into everyday life
intro.description: PSYCONOVA brings together psychology, technology and science to create innovative mental health experiences. Its approach combines virtual reality, cyberpsychology and a human perspective to offer a more accessible, intuitive and meaningful way to care for emotional wellbeing.

problema.title: Real stress, real barriers
problema.detail: Many people live with constant stress, little time and real difficulties accessing traditional mental health support.
problema.alt: Desert scene as a metaphor for exhaustion and emotional barriers

que-es.title: Psychology + technology + science
que-es.detail: PSYCONOVA is a mental health innovation platform that connects psychological knowledge, technology and applied science.
que-es.alt: Space scene as a metaphor for exploration and innovation

tecnologia.title: Virtual reality and cyberpsychology
tecnologia.detail: The experience uses immersive environments to support emotional wellbeing from an innovative and ethical perspective.
tecnologia.alt: Volcano scene as a metaphor for energy and technological intensity

exploracion.title: Self-knowledge and new possibilities
exploracion.detail: Beyond emotional relief, the experience opens space to explore identity, wonder and new ways of understanding oneself.
exploracion.alt: Library scene as a metaphor for exploration and self-knowledge

acceso.title: Simpler, more intuitive
acceso.detail: The experience is designed to be easy to live, requiring no prior knowledge and without disrupting everyday routine.
acceso.alt: Sea scene as a metaphor for accessibility and openness

impacto.title: Making mental wellbeing accessible to all
impacto.detail: It seeks to bring advanced emotional wellbeing tools to more people, contexts and ways of life.
impacto.alt: Scene with an elephant as a metaphor for impact and strength

bienestar.title: Relaxation and emotional regulation
bienestar.detail: It helps you disconnect from everyday noise and reconnect with a calmer, more mindful and emotionally regulated state.
bienestar.alt: Forest scene as a metaphor for calm and emotional regulation

services.title:
Virtual reality
for wellbeing
services.intro: PSYCONOVA offers a virtual reality service that lets users live immersive experiences designed for emotional care — from anywhere, with no prior knowledge and for as long as each person decides.

features.immersive: Immersive relaxation and emotional regulation experiences, for as long as the user decides.
features.disconnect: Disconnect from the work environment without travelling or interrupting your routine.
features.intuitive: No prior knowledge needed: the technology guides the experience intuitively.
features.anywhere: At the office, at home or anywhere private, scheduling the session around your availability.

personal.label: Personal wellbeing
personal.title: Relaxing environments for managing everyday stress
personal.desc: Immersive environments designed to reduce stress, encourage calm and restore emotional balance day to day.

professional.label: Professional use
professional.title: A tool for exploring identity and inner conflict
professional.desc: For psychologists and mental health professionals: assessment and intervention supported by virtual reality to accompany therapeutic processes.

selfKnowledge.label: Self-knowledge
selfKnowledge.title: Exploring the self
selfKnowledge.desc: Spaces for introspection where each person connects with their emotions and deepens their self-understanding through guided environments.

stories.title: Stories that accompany you
stories.subtitle: Interactive stories handed out in session, to support children through what they are living.

tale.title: Las Manadas
tale.description: Nilo is a wolf cub who lives between two caves. One day his pack starts changing shape: someone new arrives, and then a little brother.
tale.forWhom: Written for children going through a separation, a blended family or the arrival of a sibling. The story does not tell them what to feel: it gives them words for what they already feel, and shows them that feeling several things at once is fine.
tale.author: Written and designed by Laura Lesmes, Clinical Psychologist.

gate.label: Keyword
gate.hint: Your psychologist gives it to you in session, along with guidance on reading it as a family.
gate.error: That is not the keyword. Check it or ask your psychologist.

unlocked.title: Story unlocked
unlocked.note: Opens in a new tab. Works best on a tablet or computer, with the sound on.

team.title:
The clinical perspective
behind PSYCONOVA
team.subtitle: Every immersive experience is born from clinical practice: technology supports the process, professional judgement guides it.
team.label: Interdisciplinary team

lead.name: Laura Valentina Lesmes Castañeda
lead.credentials: Clinical and Health Psychologist · M.Sc. in Cyberpsychology
lead.bio: With a background in clinical psychology and a specialisation in technology applied to emotional wellbeing, she leads the scientific and therapeutic development of PSYCONOVA. Her career combines traditional clinical practice with research into virtual reality as a tool for intervention, building a bridge between modern psychology and technological innovation with a deeply human approach.

education.degree: Clinical and Health Psychology — Universidad del Rosario · University of Bologna
education.masters: M.Sc. in Cyberpsychology — Universidade Lusófona · University of Barcelona · Université Paris Cité

tech.name: Team Lead's Name
tech.bio: Responsible for the technical architecture, the development of the VR environments and the integration of the platform with clinical protocols.

legal.name: Advisor's Name
legal.bio: Ensures regulatory compliance in data protection, clinical privacy and the legal framework for using technology in mental health.

marketing.name: Strategist's Name
marketing.bio: Defines the brand voice, the communication strategy and the channels that connect PSYCONOVA with the people who need it most.
